# contabo_instance_vnc (Resource)

This resource sets the password of the VNC console of an instance. Contabo turns on the VNC console for every instance, and the API cannot turn the VNC console off. A strong VNC password is the best protection that the API offers.

The API does not return the password, so Terraform cannot see a password change that someone makes in the Customer Control Panel. When Terraform destroys this resource, the VNC console keeps the last password.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Set a strong password for the VNC console of an instance. The API cannot
# turn the VNC console off, so a strong password is the best protection.
resource "random_password" "vnc" {
  length  = 16
  special = false
}

resource "contabo_instance_vnc" "database" {
  instance_id = contabo_instance.database.id
  password    = random_password.vnc.result
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The id of the instance.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password of the VNC console. The password must have at least 8 characters, and the characters must be letters or digits. Many VNC clients only use the first 8 characters. Terraform stores the password in the Terraform state.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VNC console of the instance is enabled.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vnc_ip` (String) The IP address of the VNC console.
- `vnc_port` (Number) The port of the VNC console.
